assets.name: earthworks
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: high quality editorial photograph for the construction machinery gallery of a Turkmenistan company website. Create an original fictional representative photograph, not an actual named project. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2. Context: large civil engineering earthworks in Turkmenistan, dry layered sand and pale limestone Kopetdag foothills. Consistent palette of sand, warm cream, charcoal, muted industrial yellow and clear pale blue sky. Natural morning daylight, soft realistic shadows, documentary realism, sharp mechanical and ground texture, subtly used machinery with dust and wear. Plausible chassis, tracks, wheels, hydraulics, working distances and scale. No logos, readable text, watermarks, stylization, CGI appearance, excessive dust clouds or oversaturated orange. Full bleed photograph; keep key machinery inside a central generous safe area for a slightly tighter website crop. Main subject: one yellow tracked excavator loading soil into one plain white three-axle tipper truck on a broad construction platform. Composed from the front three-quarter side of the truck at human eye level, 40mm documentary lens. Truck in left foreground with clearly visible cab, entire truck inside frame; excavator slightly behind to right, fully visible boom and bucket over rear half of the truck's open bed. A modest natural stream of earth falls into the bed, physically credible bucket orientation. Quiet layered excavation walls and pale dry foothills form the background, enough empty space around both machines. No people walking near equipment, no fantasy buildings. Strong uncluttered composition focused on equipment at work.
